You can also right-click the icon and pick Hide.
ui.OPT_HIDE_OUTLEVELED_TIP: Hides a dungeon from the list once your level is above its level range.

Dungeons your account's Legacy Challenges show as done open too (not Ragefire Chasm, Hall of Thanes or The Stockade: Legacy can't tell them apart or doesn't list them).

ui.OPT_RPG_IMPORT_TIP: Paste the code from Export Progress on your other computer.

ui.OPT_RPG_MUTE_TIP: The achievement popups make no sound.

ui.OPT_RPG_VOLUME_TIP: How loud the achievement fanfare plays (100% = as loud as the game's own).
ui.OPT_SHOW_ALL_CLASS_TIP: Also lists class quests for other classes (for example Warlock or Paladin quests). Off: you only see your own class's quests.

ui.OPT_TRACK_HIDE_GOLD_TIP: The tracker doesn't show the money earned.
ui.OPT_TRACK_HIDE_TIME_TIP: The tracker doesn't show the run's time.

ui.OPT_TRACK_HIDE_XP_TIP: The tracker doesn't show the XP from mobs.
ui.OPT_TRACK_LOCK_TIP: The tracker can't be moved and loses its resize corner and its X. Right-click still opens Options.

ui.OPT_TRACK_SOLO: Show Tracker for solo runs too
